subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the female operative, whose appearance and costume come from <Picture 1>: a muscular athletic Asian woman in her late twenties with a low sleek bun, sharp cheekbones, intense dark eyes, small gold drop earrings, tanned skin with defined shoulders and collarbones, wearing a black satin slip evening gown with thin spaghetti straps, a deep V neckline, cross-back straps, a high slit on the left thigh, a black tactical thigh holster with a compact pistol on the left thigh, black heeled ankle boots, and holding a slender stiletto dagger with a polished metal hilt in her right hand.
<Subject 2> is the candlelit stone wine cellar, whose layout and atmosphere come from <Picture 1>: an arched brick ceiling, thick rough-hewn stone columns between aisles, rows of stacked wooden wine barrels on both sides, one long heavy oak tasting table at center, an arched stone doorway at the far end, warm flickering candlelight from wall sconces.
<Subject 3> is a broad-shouldered man in a dark tactical vest and cargo pants, short-cropped hair, first to engage with a grabbing attack.
<Subject 4> is a leaner man in a dark jacket, entering with a wild right hook.
<Subject 5> is a taller man in dark clothing who recovers from a barrel collision and re-enters from the far aisle.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a realistic cinematic action style with warm candlelit interiors and a desaturated, shadow-heavy palette.
[Shot 1] A medium-close camera tracks <Subject 1> as she presses her back against a thick stone column in <Subject 2>, the metal hilt of her dagger catching candlelight. From the left aisle, <Subject 3> lunges in and actually seizes her upper arm; she twists against his grip, ducks beneath his reach, and drives the heel of her right boot into his ribs — he folds with a grunt and stumbles back into a barrel, not down. Before he settles, <Subject 4> enters from the right with a real swinging right hook; she barely leans back, the fist grazing her cheek, then uses her free left hand to shove a loose barrel that rolls hard into his shins and breaks his advance.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a medium-wide view as she backsteps along the long oak table at frame center. <Subject 5> rises from behind the barrels at the far end of the aisle and charges. <Subject 1> plants her left hand on the table and vaults onto its surface, sliding across on her hip; her trailing right foot knocks a wine bottle that spins off and shatters on the stone. <Subject 5> grabs her ankle mid-slide and yanks — she hooks the table edge with her left hand, rotates violently over his grip, and drops behind him with a knee to his lower back that sends him to one knee. From the left edge of frame, <Subject 3> has recovered and re-enters, forcing her to abandon a finishing blow and pivot away.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the camera tightens slightly. Now flanked, <Subject 1> uses the central column to pivot as <Subject 3> and <Subject 4>, who has clambered over the barrels, close from both sides. She slips through the narrow gap between their reaching arms, her thigh-holster strap visible for a beat as she twists; as they overcommit and collide shoulder-to-shoulder, she shoves the table's leg — the heavy oak topples between them and becomes a wall. She breaks toward the arched doorway, reaches it, and turns her head for a single beat to glance back at the blocked men before she slips into the dark beyond. Candlelight flickers across the barrels; the cellar settles.

overall_soundscape:
Soft heel taps on stone, the whisper of satin fabric, the faint metallic clink of the dagger hilt, a sharp intake of breath, a meaty boot-to-rib thud and a man's choked grunt, the hollow roll of a barrel across stone and a second man's caught curse as it hits his shins, a hand slap on table wood, the skid of a body across it, the bright crash of a shattering bottle and the wet drip of spilled wine, a knee impact into a back and a choked exhale, the scrape of boots clambering over barrels, the grunt of two men colliding as the table crashes down, distant footsteps and the low crackle of candles.

non_diegetic_music:
A low, tense string drone with a slow building pulse, sparse and predatory, swelling briefly on the vault across the table and resolving into silence as she vanishes through the arch.
